answer.book: Tobias Magirus, Eponymologium criticum (1644): a Latin alphabetical dictionary of cognomina (nicknames and epithets) of ancient and early modern persons, each heading followed by its description. It is preceded by dedications, prefaces and an index, and followed by a Miscellanea onomatologica of excerpts and notes, ending with Finis. The dictionary entries are unnumbered alphabetical headings, so no numbered series is given.
